blocker.summary: r465 lifted the ac6recomp_codegen guard r464 named as needing a decision (explicit user authorization) by removing a small, isolated guard in tools/build.py -- the target is just an offline rex::rexglue codegen pass, no live Ghidra dependency. The rexglue-oracle profile now regenerates, builds (231/232 targets), and validates end-to-end for the first time since Aug 30. The oracle campaign then ran (tools/run_gate.py against routes/mission01-qualified-96.steps with --mission-render-summary --mission-d5b4-final-white) but hit an ALREADY-KNOWN, unrelated blocker: the movie worker stalls in a cinematic wait loop (same exact symptom already documented in reports/retail-us-mission01-flight-long-candidate-20260828.md, identical Xvfb frame across a 5-minute gap), stopping at 573s before any real flight gameplay. 228 files / 114 distinct shaders were captured; an exhaustive comparison against the existing 253-shader dump found ZERO new shaders -- the route never reaches the flight-gameplay draw states r456/r462 characterized as uncovered. The native profile was fully restored and verified (ctest 11/11, presented_frames=5 state=2, capture unchanged) -- no regression. Named for r466: the shader-registry-coverage-via-oracle track remains open but needs the movie-worker cinematic stall fixed FIRST (a separate, substantial pre-existing investigation, likely its own dedicated cycle) before any oracle route can reach the uncovered draw states. Still open, non-blocking: once the native PinnedShaderRuntime wiring is judged mature, reconsider the backlog commit decision (r433/r434/r438/r454-r462); update tools/prepare.py/build.py to default to the current ISO path for the native profile (r452/r453, convenience only).
